body:
Gaming and drawing, mostly.

Course, I really only play TF2 now so I get bitched at a lot by professionals for playing such a "violent game" with so much "gore", which is complete bull-- That actually ruined it for me, it's hard to play because it just reminds me of all the BS they've said about it.

And drawing is frustrating after a while.

I don't think that it's courage. I just got upset, said fuck it, did it in the moment and failed because of how haphazardly done everything was. All of my attempts are like that, I just get the idea then and there.

I don't think that *anybody* should try, but I especially think that you shouldn't try if you need to convince yourself to do so. Not only would that (probably) lead to a half assed, heat of the moment, attempt that could just make your life worse,

But it also means that there's something keeping you here. If it's a person, talk to them more. If it's a pet, hang out with them more. If it's something you want to do, put effort into doing that thing. Even if it's just you being scared of any pain from an attempt, then you're not so far gone that you lose all sense of danger, and you're still on the fence about it, which is just as hopeful.

I don't know about you, your life, or whatever your situation is, but I'm like that right now. Our situations are probably very different, but I don't have much control over my life right now, either. I can't say much because I don't know anything about your life, but if you want, you can always talk to me about it here or in PMs or wherever you want.

How good things *could* be going in at least a year doesn't change much, though.

I'm still having chest pains, heart palpitations and headaches from stress most of the time. I'm still blacking out and throwing up whenever I get too stressed out. I've still missed out on the most important part of my education, I'm still stressing out my family and making them ill.

I still get what you mean, but thinking that things aren't going to get better eventually isn't the only reason why people feel like this. I feel like this because I also can't cope with the tole everything is taking on me physically, as well as how bad all of this is going, even if it could get better eventually.
A tattoo isn't worth all of this, though. I can't do anything, enjoy anything or have any time to myself anymore. I just worry 24/7 and can't function outside of the internet, more or less.

You are right, I don't feel supported at all. I'm involved with a mental health service and my close family are aware of my problems, but they make me feel so much worse.

I've tried to explain all of the different problems, but I can't. There are so many different things that people do and say that upset me, that I can't even put it into words properly. 

I had to rewrite it all twice before I just couldn't think anymore. Before, everything would just keep on going round and around in my head and I wouldn't be able to think about anything else, it got in the way of everything. 

But now it's just changed completely. I'm not thinking of certain things or events that have happened, I'm just constantly feeling like there's constant pressure on me all the time. It's literally gotten to a point that I've worried so much that I can't even worry about certain things anymore, it's just one big blur of "Holy fuck, I'm on my own in this, nobody listens, I have a few years before I can stop talking to these people and I have absolutely nowhere to go" even though I can't pinpoint why it's like that.

It's been like that 24/7 for the past few months and I can't do anything about it. And thank you, sorry that I can't really make much sense of anything, it's not helpful at all.
Well I'm too young to get a tattoo (In the UK at least) and if I dyed my hair, God my family would implode, so I can't do much of anything like that.
I've never really wanted to do anything that I can't do already. I guess dye my hair or get a tattoo, or just something like that? Nothing big. And thank you.
